- Tue 12/22: 14:00–15:30 ET
- Wed 12/23: 10:00–11:30 ET

Quick note on format: we typically split the 90 minutes into 60 min control walkthrough + 30 min evidence/transfer and pen-test Q&A. That keeps the DPA/legal clarifications toward the end.

Availability (converted to ET/CET to cover London):
- Mon 12/21: 11:30–13:00 ET / 16:30–18:00 CET (works for an afternoon London participant)
- Tue 12/22: 15:00–16:30 ET / 20:00–21:30 CET
- Wed 12/23: 09:30–11:00 ET / 14:30–16:00 CET

If none of those fit, we can do an after-hours window Tue 12/22 19:00–20:30 ET (convenient for UK attendees). Please pick the best two options and I’ll lock one in.

Prep items for the call:
- Confirm list of ClearEdge attendees and their roles (security, legal, infra).
- Any non-standard data residency questions? (Olga — can you prepare our standard answer set.)
- Pen-test scope & vendor name — include contact if you want them on the call.

Olga and Jasmine are on the thread to confirm ops/bridge details and evidence handoff.

Best,
